statement: CISA adds a SiteGuard WAF vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry whose vendorProject or product field includes SiteGuard, with dateAdded between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: The SiteGuard WAF flaw is not added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded inside the 2026-10-19 to 2026-11-20 window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
